fullTextEN: If you have been to Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 你一定会发现到处都是7-Eleven。

fullTextEN: there are two or three 7-Elevens on one street.
7-Eleven is not just a place to buy things,

fullTextZH: 也是大家喝咖啡、聊天的地方。
fullTextEN: it's also a place for everyone to drink coffee and chat.

fullTextZH: 到底7-Eleven在台湾有多厉害呢？
fullTextEN: Just how amazing is 7-Eleven in Taiwan?

fullTextZH: 今天Bella老师就带你一起去看一看。
fullTextEN: Today, Teacher Bella will take you to have a look.

fullTextZH: 有很多人上班起床第一件事情，
fullTextEN: many people, the first thing they do when they wake up for work,
is to go to 7-Eleven to buy coffee.

fullTextZH: 这里啊，不只有普通的美式咖啡，
fullTextEN: Here, there is not only regular American coffee,

fullTextZH: 一杯美式咖啡大概需要多少钱呢？
fullTextEN: How much does a cup of Americano roughly cost?

fullTextZH: 像这样一杯大杯的美式咖啡，
fullTextEN: A large cup of Americano like this,

fullTextZH: 在冬天的时候，你也可以买热巧克力。
fullTextEN: In winter, you can also buy hot chocolate.

fullTextZH: 夏天的时候，还可以买水果茶。
fullTextEN: In summer, you can also buy fruit tea.

fullTextZH: 有很多很多不一样的选择。
还可以帮你处理大事情、小事情。
fullTextEN: it can also help you handle big and small matters.

fullTextZH: 看到我后面的这台机器吗？
fullTextEN: Do you see the machine behind me?
Want to pay phone bills or water bills?

fullTextZH: 你也可以在这台机器上，
fullTextEN: You can also use this machine,

fullTextZH: 买演唱会的票和火车票哦。
fullTextEN: to buy concert tickets and train tickets.
If you want to send something,

fullTextZH: 没问题，只要到这台机器按寄件，
fullTextEN: no problem, just go to this machine and press send,

fullTextZH: 然后再把你的包裹拿到7-Eleven，
另外啊，如果你是喝醉了，你也可以来7-Eleven，
fullTextEN: Also, if you are drunk, you can come to 7-Eleven,
and call a taxi to take you home.

fullTextZH: 可是啊，这个服务是要付钱的啊，

fullTextEN: Oh, by the way, let me teach you something,

fullTextZH: 就是把瓶子里面的酒喝完。
fullTextEN: to finish the drink in your glass.

fullTextZH: 所以啊，下次喝啤酒的时候，
fullTextEN: So, next time when drinking beer,

fullTextZH: 记得对你的朋友说"干杯"啊。
fullTextEN: remember to say "ganbei" to your friends.
If you want to drink alcohol,
You must be over 18 years old.
Also, remember not to drink and drive,

fullTextZH: 什么？这里还有这个东西？
fullTextEN: What? There's this thing here too?

fullTextZH: 没错，这里还有Pokemon的游戏机。
fullTextEN: That's right, there's also a Pokemon game console here.

fullTextZH: 所以你常常会有看到很多小朋友，
fullTextEN: So you often see many children,
waiting to play this game console.

fullTextZH: 还有像这样子的小型书店哦。
fullTextEN: there are also small bookstores like this.

fullTextZH: 你可以买到最新的杂志，
fullTextEN: you can buy the latest magazines,
So 7-Eleven is not just for buying things,
Then order a cup of coffee,
Read a book while drinking coffee,
Just like being in a coffee shop.

fullTextZH: 如果你需要一个地方等你的朋友，
fullTextEN: If you need a place to wait for your friend,
You don't know where to go,
Then coming to 7-Eleven is the right choice.
Next, I want to introduce a special 7-Eleven.
Wow! There are so many Hello Kitty items!
There are Hello Kitty bowls and plates,

fullTextZH: 连天花板都是Hello Kitty的哎！
fullTextEN: Even the ceiling is Hello Kitty themed!
Which one do you want to visit more?

fullTextZH: 不止可以买东西、吃东西、喝咖啡，
fullTextEN: You can not only buy things, eat, and drink coffee,
there are also so many services!
7-Eleven is not just a convenience store,

fullTextZH: 也是我们生活很重要的一个部分哦。
fullTextEN: it's also a very important part of our lives.

fullTextZH: 还是哪一件事情特别有意思呢？
fullTextEN: or which thing is particularly interesting?

fullTextZH: 欢迎在下面留言告诉我哦！
fullTextEN: Feel free to leave a comment below and let me know!

fullTextZH: 那我们就下支影片见喽，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Then we'll see you in the next video, bye!

fullTextZH: 哈？也太好喝了吧？这个珍珠奶茶！
fullTextEN: Huh? This bubble tea is too delicious!

fullTextZH: 什么？台湾除了珍珠奶茶，还有更多有意思的事情？
fullTextEN: What? Besides bubble tea, Taiwan has even more interesting things?

fullTextZH: 没错，现在，你只要到Lazy Chinese的网站看，你就可以有趣又好玩的台湾的文化故事哦！
fullTextEN: That's right, now, if you just go to the Lazy Chinese website, you can find fun and interesting stories about Taiwanese culture!
